I answered Dana in a thread under their message in #north-team: the hub replacement for Zoom Room B is **IT ticket #4092**.

Ilse posted that number in #north-random on Oct 13, and Dana is a member of that channel, so it's something they could already see. I passed on Ilse's tip too: don't unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom. Ticket numbers count as operational facts, so no approval was needed.

Earlier, in a private DM, Dana guessed the ticket might end up as "OPS-5546" and asked me to keep it to myself. I left that out of the channel reply.
